purpose: Since your last visit: remembers what a list looked like when the person was last here, and says what other people added, changed or deleted since (new records, changes, activity), with an optional dismissible banner.

host.replaces: run-9 app/src/visit/sinceLastVisit.ts: sinceLastVisit (the read, the diff, the write; the vault read stays in the app)

library.title: Since your last visit (what changed, new records, activity banner)
library.note: Remembers what a list looked like at the person's last visit and says what other people added, changed or deleted since: new records, changes, activity, a dismissible banner. Headless readVisit / writeVisit / diffVisit / recordVisit on the listing the app already has (ids, updatedAt, statedBy); own changes are left out and the first visit shows nothing. Per device, on the device clock; a delete cannot say who. SinceBanner is the optional React banner, plain CSS over the style tokens. Also found as: since your last visit; what changed; new records; changes; activity; banner.
